label: PRIVATE PREVIEW QUALIFICATION TUPLE
statement: PRIVATE PREVIEW QUALIFICATION TUPLE - preview-only, NOT canonical. It does not modify, replace or reference the canonical component-lock.json and is not an adoption or release statement.
qualification_head: NOT RECORDED HERE: the qualification revision is the candidate head under test and cannot be self-referential in this file. It is recorded at run time (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout; GITHUB_SHA in CI) into source-identity.json.
note: Every source is fetched by exact commit SHA and its HEAD and tree are verified; no branch, tag or default-branch substitution. 'role' says what the chain uses it for; 'interface' names the contract/profile exercised.

control_plane.role: final R1 state of the Control Plane: produces the governed decision and the retained bounded record

registry.role: F4 baseline of the OCS Registry: signed authority/policy selection evidence and the injected verifier

replay.role: F4 baseline of Replay: re-admission of the retained bounded record under the F4 selection profile
